comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Part of the Proof of Mythology (No.1) Memorial Album. This item drops randomly (and at times, rarely) from the mighty Minotaur, rumored to lurk deep within the Labyrinth endless dungeon.

You have a chance to run into this foe every 10 floors, but it's quite rare -- the Seeker of the Unknown title may help you find the Minotaur more frequently, though not by much.

Due to the Minotaur's elusive nature, I cannot presently confirm which version drops this item (the deeper you go, the more powerful it becomes, and its loot table changes depending on the version). Sorry about that, chief. On to the item stats:

Swordplay +2
Sword Mastery +2
Assault +1
7000 fame to equip

Happy mythical monster hunting to you.

PS: Apparently this can also obtained from the White Grab Bag item, which is not to be confused with the identically named White Grab Bag item. Confused? So am I. The White Bag containing this accessory has yet to be released on Maris as of my comment post. Cheers.
